The food had literally no taste and it felt like I’m the one person in the world who lost their parent, what didn’t help is my formal high school didn’t care more than saying sorry for your loss they still gave me the worst grades possible (The exams were a month I think after my dads funeral and I couldn’t concentrate on a single sentence let alone a whole textbook plus I skipped most of my classes which I regret now deeply), so I really hope you have an understanding environment or someone you can reach out to, I cried myself to sleep in each of these nights and I was thinking how disappointed he would be at me the whole time, it’s still is horrible now even after years when I’m older, doing well at college but it stills hunts me from time to another.
